mapper.select: SELECT id, post_id, parent_id, user_id, nickname, content, status, created_at FROM t_comment WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND parent_id IS NULL AND status = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, post_id, parent_id, user_id, nickname, content, status, created_at FROM t_comment WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT id, post_id, parent_id, user_id, nickname, content, status, created_at FROM t_comment WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND parent_id IS NOT NULL AND status = 1 ORDER BY created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_comment (post_id, parent_id, user_id, nickname, email, content, status, created_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{parentId}, #{userId}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{content}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_comment SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
